title: DomoView Home Pack v1
description: Describes one home: its geometry source (GLB), rooms, openings, light fixtures and optional baked render assets. Everything home-specific lives here so the card itself stays generic.

id.description: Stable slug. Also the folder name under www/domoview/homes/.

license.description: SPDX id. Use CC0-1.0 or CC-BY-4.0 for shared packs.

units.description: All coordinates are metres. Other units are intentionally not supported.

north.description: Degrees to rotate from the pack's +Y axis to geographic north. 0 means +Y points north. Solar and lunar azimuths are corrected by this value.

createdWith.description: Tool that produced the pack, e.g. 'domoview-studio 0.1.0'.

model.description: Either url or a baked section must be present; a pack with only baked images renders without geometry, and a pack with only a model renders live.

url.description: Path to the glTF-Binary, relative to home.json. Optional for a baked-only pack.

up.description: Which axis points up in the GLB. glTF mandates Y-up, but floor-plan tools commonly export Z-up; the renderer rotates accordingly.

bounds.description: World-space bounding box in pack coordinates. Used to frame cameras and to decode the baked position G-buffer.

exposure.description: Tone-mapping exposure multiplier for the live renderer.

environment.description: Ambient/sky setup for the live renderer.

cameras.description: Named viewpoints offered in the card. The first entry, or the one flagged default, is used on load.

elevation.description: Degrees above the horizon. 90 is straight down.

target.description: Look-at point. Defaults to the centre of model.bounds.

clip.description: Hide geometry above this height so interiors stay visible. Mirrors the cut-away a doll-house view needs.

levels.description: Storeys. Single-storey packs may omit this; one level named 'ground' is assumed.

polygon.description: Floor outline, counter-clockwise. Drives per-room daylight, climate chips and room-scoped shading.

label.description: Where to anchor the room's climate chip. Defaults to the polygon centroid.

outdoor.description: Balconies and terraces: lit by the open sky rather than through openings.

walls.description: Wall segments in plan. Openings reference them. Optional for packs whose GLB already carries final geometry.

flip.description: Invert the outward normal when the traced direction runs the wrong way.

openings.description: Windows, doors and glazed doors. Windows admit daylight and can carry a cover (blind/shutter) and a contact sensor.

wall.description: Wall id this opening sits in.

offset.description: Centre distance along the wall from point a, in metres.

sill.description: Lower edge above the level's floor.

head.description: Upper edge above the level's floor.

rooms.description: Rooms this opening lights. Usually one; a pass-through may list two.

mullion.description: Distance from the opening's own centre to a vertical post that blocks light, in metres.

normal.description: Outward normal override. Derived from the wall when absent.

glass.description: World-space bounds of the visible pane, used to confine rain and snow to actual glass.

inFront.description: True when the blind is seen in front of the pane from the pack's camera rather than behind it.

outside.description: Seen from outside the building in the default camera.

coverProfiles.description: Named blind/shutter response curves. Controllers rarely map position linearly to the visible opening, so a pack can measure its own curve.

stops.description: [position 0-100, visible opening height in metres], ascending by position.

slats.description: Tiltable slats let light through a closed blind.

maxAperture.description: Fraction of the pitch that opens at full tilt.

closedStops.description: [position 0-100, aperture fraction] for controllers that leak light without a tilt channel.

fixtures.description: Everything the card can bind to a Home Assistant entity and show a state for.

kind.description: Drives which HA domains are offered and how the state is visualised.

node.description: Name of the GLB node this fixture controls, for the live renderer.

domains.description: Allowed HA domains for binding, e.g. ['light','switch']. Derived from kind when absent.

emitters.description: Actual light sources. The live renderer creates one three.js light per entry; the baked renderer draws one bulb glow per entry.

intensity.description: Relative weight when a fixture has several emitters.

light.description: Photometric defaults, used when the entity reports no colour or brightness.

shadow.description: Cast a real-time shadow map. Costly; reserve for a few hero fixtures.

dimmable.description: Hint only. The card still checks supported_color_modes at runtime.

screen.description: Marker position as a percentage of the baked image, [x, y]. Only needed by the baked renderer; the live renderer projects the node instead.

bulb.description: Screen-space overlay style in the baked renderer.

emissiveNodes.description: GLB nodes whose emissive material follows this fixture's state.

variant.description: Only present when this variant is active, e.g. 'christmas'.

occluders.description: Axis-aligned boxes that block direct sun in the baked renderer. Furniture, parapets, planters.

shadowCasters.description: Outdoor rails and fences projected as line shadows on terraces.

variants.description: Seasonal or alternative dressings, selectable in the card.

model.description: Replacement GLB. Omit to reuse the base model.

baked.description: Replacement baked folder, relative to home.json.
Pre-rendered assets for the baked renderer. Absent packs work in live mode only.

size.description: Square edge length of every baked image.

camera.description: Which camera id the bake was rendered from. Baked mode locks to it.

gbuffer.description: World position and normal per pixel, so runtime sun and moon can be projected without re-rendering.

size.description: Edge length if it differs from baked.size.

exterior.description: White where the facade is seen from outside, so interior shading spares it.

glass.description: White on visible panes; confines rain, snow and blinds.

lights.description: fixture id to light-delta image. Added in linear light and scaled by brightness.

surfaces.description: Named plan polygons that receive weather effects.

wet.description: Outdoor floors that darken in rain and whiten under snow.

bindings.description: Suggested default entity mapping. Normally empty in a shared pack; the installing user maps their own entities.
